response_payload.rationale_summary: The initial query for US_TREASURY_1M_CMT treasury_yield_1mo observations failed with a typed_selector_requires_refinement error. After revising the selector to recover the three required observations, I computed the growth for the interval as of 2004-12-30 to as of 2004-12-31 (12.5%) and the growth for as of 2004-12-31 to as of 2005-01-03 (5.291005291%). Comparing these growth rates, the first interval had higher growth. The difference is 7.208994708994708994708994709 percentage points.
